paper_anchor: Section 5.3 and the complete CIFAR-10 FID table restated in Appendix J.3
statement_under_test: For f-divergences, JKO yields moderate yet consistent improvements; the named f-divergences are KL, Jensen-Shannon, and chi2.
operational_quantifier: For every named f-divergence, at least one reported JKO step size in {0.01, 1, 100} has lower mean CIFAR-10 FID than the matched no-JKO baseline.
assumptions: FID is minimized, as in the paper
the Small-Net architecture and total number of generator updates are matched
all reported JKO step sizes are included
the paper/code label Shannon denotes Jensen-Shannon
falsification_condition: At least one named f-divergence has best reported JKO mean FID greater than or equal to its no-JKO mean FID.
acceptance: the complete primary table passes its row-integrity audit
the exact consistency assertion is false in the primary table
a different-seed table independently shows the same counterexample
dropping the counterexample row makes the completeness control exit nonzero
